apple.title: Get ready to experience iPhone 18 Pro, the new Apple Watch lineup, and AirPods 5
apple.summary: Apple today introduced iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, powered by the next-generation A20 Pro chip, breakthrough Apple Intelligence capabilities, and unprecedented battery life.
apple.caption: 📷 iPhone 18 Pro, Apple Watch lineup, and AirPods 5

nvidia.title: NVIDIA to Acquire Hugging Face
nvidia.summary: NVIDIA announces intent to acquire open-source AI community leader Hugging Face, accelerating collaborative AI development, open models, and enterprise infrastructure across millions of builders.
nvidia.caption: 📷 NVIDIA and Hugging Face Enterprise Partnership

anthropic.title: Introducing Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1
anthropic.summary: Anthropic announces Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1, setting new industry records in multi-agent orchestration, complex logic reasoning, and constitutional cybersecurity safeguards.
anthropic.caption: 📷 Anthropic Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 Architecture

microsoft.title: The yield imperative: Turning AI infrastructure into useful intelligence
microsoft.summary: Rani Borkar, President of Azure Hardware Systems and Infrastructure, outlines how Microsoft Azure Maia accelerators and Copilot infrastructure translate massive compute into tangible enterprise productivity.
microsoft.caption: 📷 Microsoft Azure Hardware Systems & Infrastructure

meta.title: Introducing Muse: The World’s First Personal AI Agent Built for Everyone
meta.summary: Meta introduces Muse, an advanced multimodal personal AI agent capable of autonomous task execution, cross-platform workflows, and real-time reasoning across personal devices.
meta.caption: 📷 Meta Muse Personal AI Agent

google.title: I/O 2026: Welcome to the agentic Gemini era
google.summary: Sundar Pichai outlines Google's vision for the agentic Gemini era, introducing autonomous agents, multi-turn reasoning capabilities, and enterprise-wide developer ecosystems.
google.caption: 📷 Google I/O 2026 Agentic Gemini Era

openai.title: Perplexity trusts GPT-6 Astra with end-to-end systems
openai.summary: Perplexity uses Astra to write communications, change software, and monitor production systems, and checks in much less frequently than with earlier models.
openai.caption: 📷 Perplexity CEO Aravind Srinivas on OpenAI Astra
openai.desc: Perplexity uses Astra to write communications, change software, and monitor production systems, and checks in much less frequently than with earlier models.

intel.title: Intel Foundry and ASML Collaborate to Accelerate Industry Readiness for High-NA EUV
intel.summary: Intel Foundry and lithography leader ASML announce milestone integration of High-NA EUV scanners, paving the way for sub-14A Angstrom-era process nodes and advanced chiplet packaging.
intel.caption: 📷 Intel High-NA EUV Cleanroom Integration

dawn.name: Dawn Sci-Tech
dawn.title: China, Iran among countries that have used AI to aid spying, Anthropic says
dawn.summary: Foreign state-linked intelligence operatives have increasingly attempted to leverage frontier AI systems for automated vulnerability discovery, social engineering, and cyber espionage, according to an Anthropic threat report.

brecorder.title: 86pc of respondents experienced at least one cyber incident within the last year: survey
brecorder.summary: A nationwide enterprise technology audit reveals escalating cyber incidents across financial institutions and corporate networks, prompting urgent adoption of zero-trust architecture and automated endpoint security.
